title: Automate Linux sandbox host readiness
summary: Runtime execution has gVisor tests and setup docs, but CI promotion needs host-readiness automation and broader sandbox policy enforcement that fails closed when live prerequisites are missing.
expectedFailureModes: CI claims gVisor coverage on hosts that cannot execute the documented runner.
Sandbox fallback behavior silently weakens policy enforcement.
Host provisioning guidance depends on unstated machine-local setup.
humanEscalation: Human approval is required before making Linux gVisor dispatch mandatory in CI or changing runner host provisioning.
nextAction: Add a read-only Linux runner readiness probe and CI promotion checklist covering runsc, rootfs, network policy, and fallback behavior before enabling mandatory live dispatch.
